snapshot_metadata.note: All values read from live running API. Matrix version v1.0 is the string returned by the API and matches DEPENDENCY_MATRIX_VERSION in config.py. Weights read from DB risk_snapshot meta (confirmed identical to config.py). In-memory values match config.py — no runtime drift detected at snapshot time.

dependency_matrix.matrix_semantics: A[i][j] = influence of sector j (SOURCE) on sector i (DESTINATION). Row index i = destination sector. Column index j = source sector.
dependency_matrix.topology_note: Fully-connected 3x3 (all off-diagonal entries non-zero). Contrary to a commonly cited 2-edge simplification, the runtime matrix has 6 active dependency edges. This matters for multi-hop propagation analysis.

sector_weights.weights_version_note: No weights versioning endpoint exists. Value confirmed from: (1) config.py ENERGY_WEIGHT/WATER_WEIGHT/TRANSPORT_WEIGHT, (2) DB risk_snapshot meta field. Dynamic update possible via POST /api/v1/risk/update_weights if ENABLE_DYNAMIC_WEIGHTS=True.

classical_threshold.semantics: theta_bin governs (1) sector binarisation: y_i = I(x_i >= theta_bin), AND (2) edge activation in ClassicalOperator: edge fires iff A[i][j] >= theta_bin. Active edges at theta_bin=0.5: water<-energy(0.4 < 0.5, INACTIVE), transport<-energy(0.5 >= 0.5, ACTIVE). See edge_activation_table.
classical_threshold.in_memory_note: In-memory override. Lost on container restart. Override via POST /api/v1/risk/set_classical_threshold.

theta_cascade.semantics: Used in scenario_simulator to detect I_cl cascade: I_cl = 1 if delta(non-initiator risk) >= theta_cascade at any step. Since ClassicalOperator outputs {0,1} delta is always in {-1,0,1}, any theta_cascade in (0,1] gives same I_cl result (trivially invariant). True sensitivity is only to theta_bin.

domain_service_hardcoded_weights.note: Domain services implement additional hardcoded weights independent of matrix A.
domain_service_hardcoded_weights.implication: propagation_depth > 1 triggers second-hop paths to unsupported endpoints. Best-effort exception handling logs warning and skips. Multi-hop propagation is architecturally constrained to depth=1 for non-energy sources.
